contradictions: The operating entity named in Coral's own terms and conditions (LC International Limited, Gibraltar company no. 46808) is a different legal entity from the one historically associated with the Coral brand in older records and some third-party mirrors (Coral Interactive (Gibraltar) Limited, company no. 106323, same registered address) — the latter reportedly surrendered its own UK Gambling Commission remote licence in October 2019 when Entain consolidated its online brands onto a single licence (account 54743). This kind of entity substitution behind a stable consumer-facing brand matches the evasion pattern of fronting a licence-holder that differs from the historically disclosed operator, even though in this instance it appears to reflect a legitimate internal group restructuring rather than concealment.

Coral's own published restricted/permitted-country information (per third-party summaries) does not list Spain as a market it serves, yet the domain is the subject of a Spain-focused enforcement inquiry — implying either that the site remains technically accessible/marketed to Spanish users despite not being intended for that market, or that geo-restriction is inconsistently enforced. This sits alongside, rather than resolves, the authorisation question.

No independent, primary-source confirmation could be obtained in this session for any licence, registry, or DGOJ-authorisation claim: every attempted direct fetch of the UK Gambling Commission public register, Gibraltar company registry, Spain's DGOJ site (ordenacionjuego.es), and coral.co.uk itself returned HTTP 403. All findings above rely on secondary/aggregator sources (which themselves purport to reflect those primary registers) rather than on this investigation reading the primary registers first-hand.
analystNotes: Methodology: WebFetch (used here as the substitute for whois_lookup/gambling_licence_lookup/company_registry_lookup) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden for every target attempted in this session, including the target site itself (coral.co.uk), the UK Gambling Commission's public register and FOI pages, Gibraltar company-registry-adjacent pages, DGOJ's site, and even generic reference pages (e.g. Wikipedia, thepogg.com). A proxy status check (curl to the local agent-proxy status endpoint) showed no relay failures logged, suggesting the 403s originated from the destination sites/tooling rather than an organisational egress block, but this could not be fully disambiguated. Consequently, this brief is built entirely from WebSearch result snippets and summaries (used as a substitute for news_search and as an indirect proxy for register/registry lookups), which is a materially weaker evidentiary basis than direct primary-source reads. Core picture that emerged and is reasonably well corroborated across multiple independent secondary sources: 'Coral' is a long-standing UK bookmaker brand (est. 1926), its online service is currently operated by LC International Limited (Gibraltar company no. 46808), which holds a single UK Gambling Commission remote-gambling licence (account 54743) covering betting/casino/bingo/pool betting for Great Britain, alongside sister Entain brands (Ladbrokes, bwin, Gala, Foxy, PartyCasino). The ultimate parent is Entain plc (LSE-listed, formerly GVC Holdings). No evidence was found that Coral, LC International Limited, or Entain hold a Spanish DGOJ licence for the Coral brand specifically (Entain's DGOJ-licensed Spanish brand is bwin, via a separate Spanish entity); Coral itself appears, per third-party summaries, not to list Spain among its served markets. Recommended follow-up for the case file: (1) direct, authenticated or manually-verified pull of the UKGC public register entry for account 54743 and the historic entry for Coral Interactive (Gibraltar) Ltd; (2) a direct DGOJ registro search for 'Coral', 'LC International' and 'Entain'; (3) a proper WHOIS pull for coral.co.uk (registrant/registrar/creation-expiry dates) since only a search-snippet-level WHOIS view (registrar Nom-IQ Limited t/a Com Laude; Nominet unable to validate registrant address as of 30-Oct-2019) was obtainable here; (4) confirmation of whether coral.co.uk is technically geo-blocked for Spanish IP ranges in practice, to substantiate or rebut the accessibility question underlying the Spain enforcement interest.
